title: Valid isn't true
sub: The third film of Fit for use, the first series of Data quality: a check can say a value is allowed, or that two records agree; only a reference outside the data can say it's true. Three references for the graduation list, from the closest to the truth: the graduate, the document seen at enrolment, and the exam boards' approved lists, kept apart. Every check says which one it uses.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look, the quality bench: a warm stone wall and a dark granite bench under its lamp. Records are cream index cards, checks an inspector's gauges, and results tags tied on with string, in the verdict's colour: green passes, amber holds for a person, red stops, grey wasn't checked. Brass is the reference, steel blue a measure taken. Japan, 1800 to 1821, is painted full-frame, matte and soft-lit, with the place and year on a tag.
